question: Which of the following is the most appropriate antonym for "sufficient" as used above?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (1)** i.e. Inadequate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sufficient"** means enough to meet the needs or requirements. (पर्याप्त)
 
• The most appropriate antonym for **"sufficient"** is **"inadequate"**, which means not enough to meet the needs or requirements. (अपर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The resources provided were inadequate to complete the project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Inadequate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Abundant** (प्रचुर):

 
 
• **Example: **The region is abundant in natural resources.
 
 
 
• **Excessive** (अत्यधिक):
 
 
• **Example: **Excessive consumption of sugar can lead to health problems.
 
 
 
• **Absent** (अनुपस्थित):
 
 
• **Example: **He was absent from the meeting due to illness.
 
 

44:Tcee,

The correct answer is: **Option (3)** i.e.
